plugin.name: csd-decorator
plugin._long: Use toolkit themed decorations. Supported clients include Gtk4 and Qt6

option.name: decorate_csd
option._short: Decorate windows that already have decorations
option._long: This can be used to toggle double decorations on windows that refuse to not decorate themselves. Grouping these windows will not be possible.

option.name: ignore_views
option._short: Disable decorations for matched window types
option._long: Disables window decoration for windows matching the specified criteria.
